label.es: Secciones: los rangos de versículos en que el ULT en inglés divide un libro
label.pt: Seções: os intervalos de versículos em que o ULT em inglês divide um livro
label.en: Sections: the verse ranges into which the English ULT divides a book

sections.description: The sections of a book in the English ULT, each with its first and last verse, in order.

label.es: Pasaje: el texto de un versículo o rango con sus notas, preguntas y enlaces de palabras
label.pt: Passagem: o texto de um versículo ou intervalo, com suas notas, perguntas e links de palavras
label.en: Passage: the text of a verse or range with its notes, questions and word links

passage.description: The texts of a verse range with the notes, questions and word links in range.

ref.description: A book code and a range, such as "tit 1:1-2".

label.es: Concepto: qué es, sus nombres, sus relaciones y los libros donde aparece
label.pt: Conceito: o que é, seus nomes, suas relações e os livros em que aparece
label.en: Concept: what it is, its names, its relations and the books where it appears

concept.description: A concept of the translation helps with its names and relations, and the installed books that use it. With the obs unit installed, a tW or tA article also lists the Open Bible Stories that use it (obs.stories, with frames or a count of notes); a person, place or event lists the stories that overlap its verses, from the topics alone.

id.description: A concept id such as "ta:translate/figs-metaphor" or "tw:kt/grace".

label.es: Artículo: las secciones de un artículo de tA o tW
label.pt: Artigo: as seções de um artigo de tA ou tW
label.en: Article: the sections of a tA or tW article

article.description: The default sections of a translation academy or translation words article, or the ones asked for. A translation academy article also lists its related articles, with their titles.

section.description: A section id, or "all" for every section.

roles.description: Only the sections whose role is in the list, in article order; the rest go to `more`. Not with `section`.

label.es: Traducciones: cómo se vierte una palabra del original en los libros instalados
label.pt: Traduções: como uma palavra do original é traduzida nos livros instalados
label.en: Renderings: how an original-language word is rendered in the installed books

renderings.description: How the installed texts render the original words with one Strong number, with counts and references.

word.description: The position of a word in the original of the book.

label.es: Búsqueda: texto en los recursos instalados
label.en: Search: text in the installed resources

search.description: A full-text search over the installed resources.

books.description: Only these books (three-letter codes), or 'obs' for the Open Bible Stories.

limit.description: The most results to return (20 when absent).

label.es: Temas: personas, lugares, eventos y más, por categoría o por libro
label.pt: Temas: pessoas, lugares, eventos e mais, por categoria ou por livro
label.en: Topics: people, places, events and more, by category or by book

topics.description: The topics of a category or of a book, or the categories with their counts; installed is false without the topics module.

label.es: Libros: dónde se usa un artículo o concepto, y si el libro está instalado
label.pt: Livros: onde se usa um artigo ou conceito, e se o livro está instalado
label.en: Books: where an article or concept is used, and whether the book is installed

books.description: For each book, how often an article or concept is used there (or that the source does not cover it) and whether the book is installed. A tW or tA article also has an obs cell: the Open Bible Stories frames linked (tW) or notes (tA), none when the language has no such table, state none with installed false when the obs unit is not installed (not looked at, the unit is not installed; it is then listed in notInstalled).

article.description: A tA or tW article id ("ta:...", "tw:...").

label.es: Contexto: un pasaje con los artículos que sus notas y enlaces nombran
label.pt: Contexto: uma passagem com os artigos que suas notas e links citam
label.en: Context: a passage with the articles its notes and links name

context.description: A passage together with the default sections of the articles its notes and word links name.

ref.description: A book code and a range, such as "tit 1:1-2".

label.es: Buscar por nombre: las claves de los términos, artículos, personas y lugares que se llaman así
label.pt: Buscar por nome: as chaves dos termos, artigos, pessoas e lugares que têm esse nome
label.en: Look up by name: the keys of the terms, articles, people and places with that name

lookup.description: The ids of key terms, Academy articles, people, places and events whose name contains a word, in this language or in English, exact names first. A query with no words (only punctuation) returns no matches. It reads the maps only.

name.description: A word or name, such as "gracia", "grace", "metaphor" or "Pablo". Accents and capitals do not count.

limit.description: At most this many ids (15 when left out).

label.es: Academia: los artículos de tA que citan las notas de un libro, del más citado al menos
label.pt: Academia: os artigos de tA citados pelas notas de um livro, do mais citado ao menos
label.en: Academy: the tA articles the notes of a book cite, most cited first

academy.description: The Academy articles the translation notes of a book cite, with how many notes cite each, most cited first. `covered` is false when the language has no own tN, or one that does not cover the book; `articles` is then empty because there is no source, not because nothing is cited. It reads the language map; for English it also reads the notes of the xmap.

label.es: Historias: las historias bíblicas (OBS) de un pasaje, o todas
label.pt: Histórias: as histórias bíblicas (OBS) de uma passagem, ou todas
label.en: Stories: the Bible stories (OBS) of a passage, or all of them

stories.description: The Open Bible Stories whose ranges meet a passage or a whole chapter, or all of them in order.

ref.description: A book code and a chapter or a range, such as "gen 1" or "gen 1:1-2:3". Absent: every story.

label.es: Historia: una historia bíblica (OBS) con sus cuadros, notas, preguntas y enlaces
label.pt: História: uma história bíblica (OBS) com seus quadros, notas, perguntas e links
label.en: Story: a Bible story (OBS) with its frames, notes, questions and links

story.description: One Open Bible Story with its frames and, per frame, the notes, questions and word links, when the stories are installed.

n.description: The number of the story, 1 to 50.
